_desc: Site-wide SEO and infrastructure. Feeds <title>, meta tags, canonical URLs, OG/Twitter cards, JSON-LD, sitemap and manifest. Person-level facts come from profile.json; 'knowsAbout' is derived from skills.json.
_sources: siteTitle/description/keywords DERIVED from resume professional summary + GitHub bio. domain/ogImage/favicon/analytics: NOT PROVIDED — see report.

_fields.domain: Deployment domain incl. https:// — canonical URL, sitemap, OG links.
_fields.description: 1-2 sentence meta description (~150 chars). Also used in JSON-LD.
_fields.keywords: SEO keywords as an array of strings.
_fields.ogImage: Path under /images/meta/ (1200x630), or 'generate' for a simple text-based one.
_fields.favicon: Path to an icon file under /images/meta/, or 'generate-from-initials'.
_fields.analyticsUrl: Public analytics script URL (not a secret). "" if none.

description: AI engineer specializing in machine learning, NLP, Generative AI, and RAG pipelines — building end-to-end AI solutions from data engineering to scalable deployment.
